name: Almawarid Manpower Company
summary: Almawarid Manpower Company provides recruitment services for domestic and expatriate labor services to domestic workers and temporary employment agencies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers manpower, building maintenance and cleaning, and other human resource services; marketing, call center, and logistics services. It also engages in the operation of training centers, resale of telecommunication services, operation of group housing, and wholesale of uniforms. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
